prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: photorealistic hero illustration for an upholstery workshop landing page; this is a generated illustration, not documentary evidence of an actual completed job.
Primary request: Create one landscape 3:2 image, 1536 x 1024 pixels or higher, of a single realistic modern off-road buggy / UTV bucket seat standing upright on an upholstery workshop bench.
Subject: A complete tall bucket seat with its full integrated headrest, backrest, supportive side bolsters and seat cushion visible. Front three-quarter view, at seat height, with two believable integrated harness openings high in the backrest. Matte charcoal-black upholstery, fine natural grain, neatly fitted panels, subtle deep navy-blue stitching and restrained deep-blue side accent. Precise, plausible premium upholstery craftsmanship.
Scene/backdrop: Understated real-looking upholstery workshop with a dark organized tool wall softly blurred in the background and a warm grey worn workbench. Restrained warm ambient tones. The bench surface below the seat remains visible. No distracting foreground props.
Style/medium: Premium product photography, natural physical materials, crisp stitching and seam details, soft directional warm window/workshop light, gentle shadows, realistic perspective and proportions, modest depth of field, neutral subdued contrast.
Composition/framing: One seat centered in the landscape frame with generous empty margins on all sides; keep the entire seat comfortably within the central 55 percent of image width and central 84 percent of image height so the image also works cropped to a portrait hero. Show the complete top and bottom without clipping. The seat is the dominant focal point.
Constraints: No human, no hands, no logos, no lettering, no text, no watermarks, no motorcycle saddle, no car interior, no steering wheel, no second seat, no racing decals. This must unmistakably be a freestanding full-back buggy / UTV bucket seat, not a low motorcycle saddle. Opaque full-frame image.
intendedUse: Hero illustration for buggy/UTV seat upholstery landing page
disclosure: Сгенерированная иллюстрация кресла багги; не фотография выполненной работы.
conversion: PNG to WebP with sharp, quality 88, effort 6; no crop or creative editing
alt: Чёрное ковшеобразное кресло багги с тёмно-синей строчкой на верстаке в мастерской — иллюстрация.
